g.text: GPIO6-11 are wired to the internal flash: never use them (not broken out on this board).

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: ADC2 pins cannot use analogRead() while Wi-Fi is on. Use ADC1 pins (GPIO32-39) for analog + Wi-Fi.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: All GPIOs are 3.3V logic only (not 5V tolerant). GPIO34-39 have no internal pull-up/pull-down.
